note: Attacker-controlled LATM AudioSpecificConfig sets base_sr_index to a value (13-15) whose GF_M4ASampleRates entry is 0, causing invalid sample rate.
Stack buffer of 4096 bytes declared to hold one LATM frame.

code: size = 0; while (1) { u32 tmp = gf_bs_read_int(bs, 8); size += tmp; if (tmp!=255) break; }
note: Frame size is read from the bitstream; attacker controls the bytes so size can exceed 4096.

code: if (gf_bs_available(bs) < size) { gf_bs_seek(bs, pos-3); return GF_FALSE; }
note: size is only bounded by available bytes in the input, not by the 4096-byte stack buffer.
Writes size bytes into the 4096-byte stack buffer latm_buffer; when size > 4096 this is a stack-buffer-overflow WRITE.
Reads latm_frame_size bytes from latm_buffer; if latm_frame_size exceeds the initialized region, this is a stack-buffer-overflow READ.
The fix commit d443c0a7b adds this check to reject invalid base_sr_index values before the buffer operations, preventing the overflow.
